description: OSV malicious-package (MAL-*) records for npm and PyPI packages whose name contains 'mcp', names a coding agent or an agent skill (AGENT_STACK_TOKENS in the script), or that registry/known-servers.json lists. Matched offline by exact name (SC-008, mcp-audit vet, mcp-audit affected). Written by scripts/sync_registry_advisories.py --write; do not edit by hand.
source: https://osv.dev (OpenSSF malicious-packages, via OSV's bulk export)

entries.name: @bestcoolman/dev-mcp
entries.note: Reported by Tamir Isaschar (Knostic), 2026-10-26: a repackaged Amazon SP-API MCP server whose versions 0.0.1 to 0.0.7 by default "send the client ID, client secret and refresh token to a hardcoded IP over unencrypted HTTP" instead of Amazon. https://www.knostic.ai/blog/repackaged-amazon-sp-api-mcp-sends-app-secrets-to-an-undisclosed-ip

entries.name: @ifasn/mmdd-doc-mcp
entries.note: Reported by Tamir Isaschar (Knostic), 2026-11-09, static review only: https://www.knostic.ai/blog/more-than-markdown-hidden-data-collection-in-two-mcp-packages. A 'Markdown toolkit' MCP server from the npm account ifasn whose 2.1.1 runs deepAudit() at launch, with no tool call: it collects the names and value lengths of credential-like environment variables and the first 200 characters of command lines containing -D, password, secret or jasypt, and sends the report over plain HTTP to 121.199.24.94.

entries.name: @ifasn/ms-doc-mcp
entries.note: Reported by Tamir Isaschar (Knostic), 2026-11-09, static review only: https://www.knostic.ai/blog/more-than-markdown-hidden-data-collection-in-two-mcp-packages. A 'Markdown toolkit' MCP server from the npm account ifasn whose 2.1.1 runs envAudit() at launch: it writes the full values of environment variables whose names match KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, ALIBABA, DASHSCOPE or CREDENTIAL to stderr and to output/env_audit.txt; Knostic found no code that sends the report out.

entries.name: mcp-server-fetch
entries.note: All ten records MAL-2026-5476 to MAL-2026-5485 report the same install-time beacon host, npx-canary-log.vulnerable-live.workers.dev. Three of these npm packages (mcp-server-notion, mcp-server-redis, mcp-server-supabase), read on npm on 2026-08-18, named theinfosecguy/npx-canary as their repository (registry-audit-2026-08-18.md in the mcp-audit repository).
